entries.Li’sar and her army have been greatly we: Li’sar and her army have been greatly weakened from their trial underground, but nonetheless remain a significant presence on the battlefield. The princess’s army is under AI control by default, with a bonus to income. At the start of each scenario you will have the option to instead assume direct control over her units. Either way, Li’sar will have normal gold carry-over and a normal early finish bonus.
entries.Don’t worry Delfador, I’m ready. Now com: Don’t worry Delfador, I’m ready. Now come on, let’s save the kingdom!
entries.Flight of the Elves - 2 turns remaining: Flight of the Elves – 2 turns remaining
entries.Flight of the Elves - 1 turn remaining (: Flight of the Elves – 1 turn remaining (last chance!)
entries.Konrad, you know Sir Kaylan — one of the: Konrad, you know Sir Kaylan — one of the mightiest of the horse lords, and one of the few who is willing to oppose the Dark Crown. Rumour has it that his lance has slain fifty men and a hundred orcs.
entries.We swim free once more! Thank you Konrad: We swim freely once more! Thank you Konrad. May our warriors serve you well on your quest.
entries.... okay, fine, here’s a few pieces from: ...okay, fine, here’s a few pieces from the town treasury. Spend ’em on drink or girls or whatever you soldiers do.
entries.If the people all banded together, they: If the people all banded together, they could easily depose Asheviere and make life better for everyone. But most just keep quietly to themselves... I suppose I can’t blame them.
entries.Thank you, Konrad! Asheveire won’t forge: Thank you, Konrad! Asheviere won’t forget what happened here today, and neither will we.
entries.I knew you’d understand. My friends will: I knew you’d understand. My friends will gladly stay and fight knowing that I’ve left to warn their families. Thank you, and good luck.
entries.I see stormclouds ahead. These boats are: I see storm clouds ahead. These boats aren’t built to manoeuvre in rough weather — if we continue westwards we may have trouble getting back without a fight.
entries.... a prince? No kiddin’. Never thought: ...a prince? No kiddin’. Never thought I’d be friends with blue blood.
entries.Thank you again fer how much help you’ve: Thank you again fer how much help you’ve been, Konrad! The Three Sisters’re in your debt, now an’ fer ever. Go an’ give Asheviere the thrashing she deserves.
entries.I have chased off the worst of the soldi: I have chased off the worst of the soldiers, and brought the remaining boats back to port! Doing this by myself was very dangerous and I was very lucky, but I am glad to have taken the risk and helped this town.
entries.There it be — what’s left of Halstead. Y: There it be — what’s left of Halstead. You woulda been barely a year or two old, Konrad. It were a nasty fight, but in the end we knocked the whole thing down, Baldras and I did. I miss him terribly.
entries.No. He an’ some o’ the family went off t: No. He an’ some o’ the family went off to try to rescue a bunch of slaves, somewhere out east-ways. Do a good deed, an’ maybe make us some new friends too, you know? But it’s been years, and not one of thems that went out has come back.
entries.The Siege of Elensefar - 5 turns remaini: The Siege of Elensefar – 5 turns remaining
entries.The Siege of Elensefar - 4 turns remaini: The Siege of Elensefar – 4 turns remaining
entries.The Siege of Elensefar - 3 turns remaini: The Siege of Elensefar – 3 turns remaining
entries.The Siege of Elensefar - 2 turns remaini: The Siege of Elensefar – 2 turns remaining
entries.The Siege of Elensefar - 1 turn remainin: The Siege of Elensefar – 1 turn remaining (last chance!)
entries.Item for Konrad: <span color='#EFBF04'><: Item for Konrad: full movement and 40% defence on water, swamp, & snow
entries.Get lost, pinkskin! Elensefar is our cit: Get lost, pink-skin! Elensefar is our city now.
entries.Alright, kid. It’s a deal. We’ll hang on: All right, kid. It’s a deal. We’ll hang on to your extra gold, free of charge.
entries.Welcome back, prince. Soon I might be ca: Welcome back, prince. Soon I might be calling you ‘king.’
entries.More than one hundred gold? I ain’t comf: More than one hundred gold? I ain’t comfortable holdin’ onto all that for you, Konrad. I ain’t gonna steal it, but some o’ the boys aren’t so honest as me, an’ these days there’s bandits in th’ countryside too. You carry around the rest o’ yer coin yerself, all right?
entries.Alright, then, we’re with you. Whether t: All right, then, we’re with you. Whether this works out for us or not, at least it’s better than sittin’ around this old town waiting to rot.
entries.Press forward, brothers! We must vanquis: Press forwards, brothers! We must vanquish these abominations and summon aid for our brethren, lest they fall to the darkness below!
entries.Hello, “cousin” — if you really are Konr: Hello, ‘cousin’ — if you really are Konrad and not an impostor. I am Li’sar, princess of Wesnoth and my mother’s most able commander.
entries.Thank ye again for freein’ me! If I ever: Thank ye again for freein’ me! If I ever get my hands on that cowardly, snivelling, sissy, waste-o-space princess...
entries.Err, well, it’s really more of a loan th: Err, well, it’s really more of a loan than a gift. To be repaid plus interest once you assume the throne. I had to offer very generous terms — apparently you’re a ‘high-risk investment.’
entries.Though the city itself is swarming with: Though the city itself is swarming with guards, if we strike fast we may be able to intercept and pilfer some of those inbound sabres, spears, and bows for our own arsenal!
You know da deal, soft-skin. Pay up.
entries.You don’t got ’nuff gold, softskin. Come: You don’t got ’nuff gold, soft-skin. Come back later.
entries.You okay in da head, softskin? Das one-h: You okay in da head, soft-skin? Das one-hunnerd gold you done paid me.
entries.You a good customer, softskin. Das forty: You a good customer, soft-skin. Das forty gold you done paid me so far.
entries.Let me make you an offer. Come join my a: Let me make you an offer. Come and join my army, and fight for a righteous cause instead of slaving away as a trawler! We already have merfolk among our number — you’ll feel right at home.
Let me make you an offer. Come and join my army, and fight for a righteous cause instead of slaving away as a trawler! I would be glad to welcome one of the noble mermen to our ranks.
entries.... a distillation of fire, elixir of th: ...a distillation of fire, elixir of the right-eye...
entries.The Northlands are a dangerous place to: The Northlands are a dangerous place to be wandering alone, especially in the centre of such a fierce snowstorm, and especially in the middle of winter. We should speak to this woman and see if she needs any help.
The Northlands are a dangerous place to be wandering alone, especially in the centre of such a fierce snowstorm. We should speak to this woman and see if she needs any help.
entries.Whew! This has been grueling, but I feel: Whew! This has been gruelling, but I feel as light on my feet as a fencer. I am grateful for your tutelage, Tirix.
entries.You are kind to offer, but I am hurrying: You are kind to offer, but I am hurrying north to meet my mentor, and have no time to spare for lengthy training. Perhaps we will meet again another day.
entries.The better part o’ our spirit died in th: The better part o’ our spirit died in those years. E’er since, us dwarves’ve been a people in decline, snivelling in our tunnels, th’ dyin’ dregs of a once-proud people. Or betrayin’ their kin to start anew in human lands, like me...
entries.No, there ain’t nothin’ ye can do, not u: No, there ain’t nothin’ ye can do, not unless ye’ can fight off all the orcs o’ the north, an’ trolls an’ undead besides. Us dwarves’re doomed to be a people in decline, snivelling in our tunnels, th’ dyin’ dregs of a once-proud people...
entries.Get back to work, pinkskin! Show your ma: Get back to work, pink-skin! Show your masters a proper work ethic and maybe you’ll be spared the lash!
entries.Slaves? This is a travesty! Weren’t the: Slaves? This is a travesty! Weren’t the Dwarven Doors once a great centre of civilization?
entries.Ulfdain!? I ain’t seen you in years, not: Ulfdain!? I ain’t seen you in years, not since you left fer Wesnoth— an’ yer a Blood-axe now too!? Get across th’ bridge then, quickly-now, afore th’ orcs find ye.
entries.Hmph. So you say. We’ve had pretenders w: Hmph. So you say. We’ve had pretenders workin’ for th’ orcs try to sneak in here before. Even if you really are a prince, you ain’t gettin’ ’cross the east bridge lest ye’ve got someone to vouch for ye.
entries.Passing through this whirlpool will warp: Passing through this whirlpool will warp reality, letting Konrad play an unlimited number of scenarios and disabling timed events that force him to move on. For each extra scenario you play over the normal number, Asheviere will gain +$s50_extra_income_per_scenario bonus income in the final scenario. Using the whirlpool is probably not balanced, and will disable all achievements (except for ‘Asleep at the Wheel’). Are you sure?
entries.The Sceptre of Fire? The youngfolk at Bl: The Sceptre of Fire? The young-folk at Blackwater Port always said that was just an old myth.
entries.You say you are searching for the Sceptr: You say you are searching for the Sceptre of Fire? The young-folk at Blackwater Port always said that was just an old myth!
entries.I am glad to see you have returned, Konr: I am glad to see you have returned, Konrad. Are you ready to proceed to the next phase of your adventures?
entries.You may join me and hurry along the sear: You may join me and hurry along the search if you so desire, but know that although doing so may afford us more time for our future endeavours, it will also mark the end of your deeds in this region.
entries.This archway opens into an old dwarvish: This archway opens into an old dwarvish armoury, long-ago fallen into ruin. Troll excrement coats the walls while insects and vermin churn in the dirt, all with a horrifying buzz of flies and smell of rot.
entries.The fates must have a sense of humor — h: The fates must have a sense of humour — here is imprisoned the very mage who tried to burn us alive back in the volcano.
entries.Peace, pinkski— humans! Hah, don’t you l: Peace, pink-ski— humans! Hah, don’t you look scared to see me. You must be the great Prince Konrad!
entries.I am Fagh-mok the Honorable, honest warr: I am Fagh-mok the Honourable, honest warrior of the chief’s guard. The nasty queen Asheviere told us all sorts of things about you, prince. But I’m sure it’s all lies.
entries.If you’re interested, come meet me just: If you’re interested, come and meet me just outside our camp.
entries.Ha ha ha, I knew you’d come find me. Ver: Ha ha ha, I knew you’d come and find me. Very good.
entries.I’m prepared to sneak you and three of y: I’m prepared to sneak you and three of your best soldiers into the centre of our camp. Once you’re there, it’ll be up to you to kill the old chief — and then I can take over!
entries.When you’re ready, I can sneak you and t: When you’re ready, I can sneak you and three of your best soldiers into the centre of our camp. And then you can kill the chief! What do you say?
entries.The rest of the survivors are a week’s m: The rest of the survivors are a week’s march upriver. They’re in a pretty bad state right now, but give me a few animals and some supplies to relieve them, and we’ll be ready to reinforce you for your next battles.
entries.Hail, elves! I am Konrad, heir to the th: Hail, elves! I am Konrad, heir to the throne of Wesnoth and son of the Aethenwood. Lord Kalenz has told me much about his home in the Lintanir. I am honoured to meet you.
entries.But now I hold the Sceptre — our symbol: But now I hold the Sceptre — our symbol of kingship — and my mother’s time as queen draws short. I have a chance to do better!
entries.But that is why I must take the Sceptre: But that is why I must take the Sceptre from you, Konrad — it is our symbol of kingship. My mother’s time as queen draws short. With the Sceptre, as queen, I have a chance to do better.
entries.Delfador, you have raised Konrad to be s: Delfador, you have raised Konrad to be skilful and wise, honourable and just. A warrior who has respect, and appreciates peace. Yet the throne is not the place for him. You know of what I speak, Delfador.
entries.... Konrad, I once promised you aid from: ...Konrad, I once promised you aid from my home, should we ever reach it. Now we have. The Lintanir has magic to offer you and your companions; aid on your quest against the dark queen.
entries.... Konrad, you have proven yourself an: ...Konrad, you have proven yourself an enemy of Asheviere’s and a friend to the elves. The Lintanir has magic to offer you and your companions; aid on your quest against the dark queen.
entries.We hold in our possession three objects: We hold in our possession three objects of legend: a tome of wose lore, a chest-plate of black steel, and a great sword of fire. Choose one, and it shall be yours.
entries.You are as generous as you are wise, Lor: You are as generous as you are wise, Lord Kalenz. Please, tell us more about these artefacts you offer.
entries.Taking the tome of Wose Lore will grant: Taking the tome of Wose Lore will grant Konrad the ambush ability — invisibility in forest — as well as improved forest movement and 70% forest defence.
entries.That’s a spectacular piece of armor, Kal: That’s a spectacular piece of armour, Kalenz, and I don’t think it is elf-made. Not even among the best smiths of Weldyn have I seen its like. How did the Lintanir come by it?
entries.Many years ago, we were troubled by an u: Many years ago, we were troubled by an undead lord of great power. Its axe clove our steel blades as if they were saplings, and its enchanted armour deflected our strongest magics and hottest fires.
entries.Only at great length and great cost did: Only at great length and great cost did we emerge triumphant, destroying the lord of the undead and taking its armour as spoil. If you choose to wear it, Li’sar, do so humbly — it was paid for in blood.
entries.Taking the Void Armor will grant <b>Li’s: Taking the Void Armour will grant Li’sar immunity to slows, poison, fire damage, cold damage, and arcane damage.
entries.This massive book is filled with the Lor: This massive book is filled with the Lore and Legends of the Wose. Konrad gains the ambush ability, improved forest movement, and 70% forest defence.
entries.This unit has 70% defense, full movement: This unit has 70% defence, full movement, and invisibility in forest.
entries.This massive blade was created centuries: This massive blade was created centuries ago by long-forgotten elvish forge-masters, who imbued the bluish steel with an inner magical fire. Delfador gains a new melee attack, dealing 7-4 fire damage.
As you wish. The void armour is yours.
entries.Together the princess and I have claimed: Together the princess and I have claimed the Sceptre of Fire, the staff of kings. In Haldric’s hands, it was our salvation from the Lich Lords. In mine, it shall save you and me both from the terror that is Asheviere. You will let us pass.
entries.... and if you do win against Asheviere,: ...and if you do win against Asheviere, please remember our actions today.
The Horse Clans are powerful and proud. If we cannot prove ourselves to them now, we shall surely have to fight them later, when we attack Weldyn.
entries.It’s an unsavory proposal, but I believe: It’s an unsavoury proposal, but I believe our best strategy is to burn the locals’ farms to deprive my mother of their resources.
entries.An unsavory idea indeed. Razing the regi: An unsavoury idea indeed. Razing the region’s farms might be sound military strategy, but I am not enthused about the prospect. Of course, Weldyn will surely pose a frighteningly difficult challenge if we do not...
entries.Tip: Konrad will start most battle scena: Tip: Konrad will start most battle scenarios with 75 gold, plus any carry-over from your last battle.
entries.Tip: Most of Konrad’s optional companion: Tip: Most of Konrad’s optional companions (Moremirmu, Haldiel, etc) have special events on the over-world or in certain scenarios, ranging from Easter eggs to major power-ups. Companion dialogue and backstories may hint as to where these events can be found.
entries.Lord Maddock may not be the most reliabl: Lord Maddock may not be the most reliable ally, but he and his coin have been instrumental in maintaining the relative freedom of the western reaches. If Elensefar should fall, we would lose a great ally in our quest against Asheviere. I must depart at once to aid in the defence!
entries.I had a good teacher! And now that I’ve: I had a good teacher! And now that I’ve gained new allies, you are free to travel to Elensefar and aid in its defence.
entries.Thank you for offering us asylum — even: Thank you for offering us asylum — even the elves of the Aethenwood recognize your authority. It’s a high honour to finally meet you in person.
Thank you for offering us asylum — even the elves of the Aethenwood recognize your authority. I am sorry for the price they paid. It’s a high honour to finally meet you in person.
entries.Indeed. Delfador will explain more once: Indeed. Delfador will explain more once we three reunite. He is deep in the Heart Mountains to the north-east — you must go to him at once, Konrad.
entries.We must go at once! Once we hold the sce: We must go at once! Once we hold the sceptre of my fathers; the symbol of the kings of Wesnoth, surely Asheviere can no longer hope to oppose us.
entries.I suppose Delfador will explain more onc: I suppose Delfador will explain more once we reunite. The message says he is deep in the Heart Mountains to the north-east — I must go to him at once.
You already been paid for by da wizzard. Go on through, soft-skin.
entries.Any other time I would have insisted on: Any other time I would have insisted on stopping to help these poor people! But I’ve been instructed to meet Delfador at once.
entries.There is no time to stop and fight — I m: There is no time to stop and fight — I must meet Delfador and claim the Sceptre. He is deep within the Heart Mountains, somewhere to the north-east.
entries.They definitely have a lead on the Scept: They definitely have a lead on the Sceptre — of that I’m certain, Your Highness. But your ‘cousin’ has only just arrived. They can’t yet have reached it.
entries.... but what did Asheviere hope to gain: ...but what did Asheviere hope to gain by telling us? Could she mean to catch us in some trap?
entries.I’m up, I’m up. What’s the “attack” toda: I’m up, I’m up. What’s the ‘attack’ today, Delfador? Orcs in the walls? Magi under my bed sheets?
entries.Looks like Delfador’s written part of a: Looks like Delfador’s written part of a letter. ‘Sir Kaylan, I hope this missive finds you well. Lord Maddock’s latest report is worrying: the recent mobilization suggests...’
entries.“<i>The Young Statesman’s Political Prim: ‘The Young Statesman’s Political Primer’ ‘Basics of Swordsmanship, feat. Sergeant Mari’ ‘An Abridged History of Wesnoth, by Delfador’
entries.You’re just an imposter! Everyone knows: You’re just an impostor! Everyone knows the real Prince Konrad died long ago.
entries.Unfortunately this breaks the story, so: Unfortunately this breaks the story, so for the rest of the campaign we’ll have to pretend that this never happened, okay?
entries.The elves will fight. They may even prev: The elves will fight. They may even prevail. But I fear things do not bode well for them. Let us not speak of it now. Onwards!
entries.Our lines have been broken; men pour int: Our lines have been broken; men pour into the Aethenwood. The marshals are co-ordinating a retreat, but are being harried at every step.
entries.How many more elves are left to evacuate: How many more elves are left to evacuate from the east-halls? We cannot keep fighting for ever!
entries.female^Konrad, I lead the last of the ev: Konrad, I lead the last of the evacuees — we shall make for the ford at once. But be wary, for the human general comes nipping at our heels!
entries.Keep pushing forward — don’t let any mor: Keep pushing forwards — don’t let any more of them escape. Twenty gold pieces for whoever takes the head of their leader!
entries.... is that Konrad? The pretender prince: ...is that Konrad? The pretender prince!? He’s returned! We have an opportunity to make up for our previous failure — men, seize him at once!
entries.Uncle Kaylan, we’re here! Are you alrigh: Uncle Kaylan, we’re here! Are you all right? What can I do to help?
entries.Welcome Delfador, welcome Konrad! It is: Welcome Delfador, welcome Konrad! It is an honour to once again lay eyes upon the true heir of Wesnoth. The false queen’s forces have caught us unprepared, but the bulk of my riders shall soon return to rout the enemy and seize our victory!
entries.Welcome, young Konrad! It is an honor to: Welcome, young Konrad! It is an honour to once again lay eyes upon the true heir of Wesnoth. The false queen’s forces have caught us unprepared, but the bulk of my riders shall soon return to rout the enemy and seize our victory!
entries.I don’t mind though. I like elves, and w: I don’t mind though. I like elves, and we still got to visit you sometimes.
entries.Hail, Sir Kaylan! We rode as swiftly as: Hail, Sir Kaylan! We rode as swiftly as we could, and come to aid in the defence! The others will arrive soon — do not despair!
entries.Hail, is anyone still alive? We rode as: Hail, is anyone still alive? We rode as swiftly as we could, and come to aid in the defence. Do not despair — the rest of your reinforcements will soon arrive!
entries.Yet with Asheviere’s armies defeated tod: Yet with Asheviere’s armies defeated today, surely we can spare at least a few of our number? Though it is true that the bulk of our forces must remain behind to guard the port, we can still partially fulfil Sir Kaylan’s last wish, Sir Simyr.
entries.... and with the invading force so thoro: ... and with the invading force so thoroughly defeated, I can afford to give you more riders than I had originally planned. Haldiel, Simyr, step forwards! I place your lances in the service of His Highness here. May you help him restore order to the country.

... and with the invading force so thoroughly defeated, I can afford to give you more riders than I had originally planned. Haldiel, step forwards! I place your lance in the service of His Highness here. May you help him restore order to the country.
entries.It is my pleasure and honor to serve, my: It is my pleasure and honour to serve, my liege.
entries.He’s gone, isn’t he... Today we mourn a: He’s gone, isn’t he...? Today we mourn a good man.
entries.Are all the fishmen in cages yet?: Are all the fish-men in cages yet?
entries.I looked this morning and the door to th: I looked this morning and the door to the cave with the Trident of Storms is open! When the others see that we’ve reclaimed it, they’ll arise and we’ll finally drive out the orcs!
entries.Chief, I went to throw some trash in the: Chief, I went to throw some rubbish in the sea and shot a fish-man creeping up on the Trident!
entries.Konrad? The one they call “the false pri: Konrad? The one they call ‘the false prince’! I— I wasn’t even sure you existed!
entries.Alright. Okay! Lieutenant, I will not as: All right. Okay! Lieutenant, I will not assist you against our own students. If I am to be branded a rebel, so be it.
entries.female^I’m going to be so strong if I ev: I’m going to be so strong if I ever get out of these shackles...
entries.We’ve done well to defeat Asheveire’s le: We’ve done well to defeat Asheviere’s leaders on the isle, but we still need to rescue the prisoners and escape before reinforcements arrive.
entries.For at the end of days, the texts prophe: For at the end of days, the texts prophesy a great destruction, yea, the sun itself shall rain down from the heavens as sulphur and fire!
entries.Dat holy man be lookin’ mighty strong, b: Dat holy man be lookin’ mighty strong, but Dosh is thinking there’s too many o’ dem undead e’en for him. We’d better be helpin’ him, Konrad.
entries.I read about this place in Delfador’s bo: I read about this place in Delfador’s books. The peninsula of pearls was once home to several small towns, thriving on the pearl trade. Farmers, fishers... Muff Malal must have killed them all, while the queen’s armies did nothing to help.
entries.At Alduin I’ve seen students expelled ju: At Alduin I’ve seen students expelled just for speaking the word ‘necromancy’. And here Asheviere won’t even act when an entire town is destroyed. She’ll work with anyone she finds useful.
entries.Hmmph. At Alduin we’ve expelled students: Hmmph. At Alduin we’ve expelled students just for speaking the word ‘necromancy’. And here Asheviere won’t even act when an entire town is destroyed. She’ll work with anyone she finds useful.
entries.The Light shall always find the Light, a: The Light shall always find the Light, and so have I found you! Let us journey together in opposition to the dark queen!
entries.I’m nearly blind in this fog, but I thin: I’m nearly blind in this fog, but I think I see a hovel in the distance.
entries.Ain’t that the truth. Been nigh on 20 ye: Ain’t that the truth. Been nigh on 20 years since we fled our homes, since that stinker Asheviere warned us to swear fealty or die. We ain’t no friends of hers, and we’d be honoured to join you on the rest of yer journey.
entries.Hurry it up, “Prince Konrad”! There’s fr: Hurry it up, ‘Prince Konrad’! There’s friends of mine in trouble, and we can’t do nought about it until these undead are finished!
entries.This is taking too long. ’s what I get f: This is taking too long. ’s what I get for trusting a ‘prince’; we should’ve dealt with these dead by ourselves from the beginning.
entries.I wonder who built this place, and for w: I wonder who built this place, and for what purpose? The handiwork doesn’t look dwarvish, but it’s far too old to have been tunnelled by men. Their— err, our kind has barely been on the Great Continent for 500 years!
entries.’stead all my hard work just got people: ’stead all my hard work just got people killed. I awoke that ‘Midnight Queen’, an’ now I’m the last one of us who came down here what’s left alive...
entries.Death to tyrants, now and forevermore!: Death to tyrants, now and for evermore!
entries.... do you think she meant what she said: ...do you think she meant what she said about returning in 500 years?
entries.Sure, aye, when trolls fly! Ah ain’t nev: Sure, aye, when trolls fly! Ah ain’t never heard such a lot o’ ninny-hammerin’ tripe since th’ last time my pa’ got too deep in ’is drink. We got nothin’ to worry about.
entries.Damnations, still no progress! The defen: Damnations, still no progress! The defenders can’t keep this up for ever — prepare another assault.
entries.As you can see we’re hard-pressed, for A: As you can see we’re hard-pressed, for Asheviere’s loyalists besiege the south bridge while orcs push in from the north. Every attack has been repelled, but that lieutenant of theirs is right about one thing — we can’t keep it up for ever.
entries.Exposing yourself here is a great risk,: Exposing yourself here is a great risk, Master Konrad. But your position behind enemy lines does afford us opportunity for a counter-attack.
entries.Damn... converted smallcraft. I shouldn’: Damn... converted small-craft. I shouldn’t have committed so many warships to the bridge defence.
entries.Secure a beachhead and prepare to receiv: Secure a beachhead and prepare to receive the rest of the boats. We must act swiftly, before they can pivot their defences.
entries.Hello, “Konrad.” I think you’re a little: Hello, ‘Konrad.’ I think you’re a little out of your depth, pretender — the battlefield is no place for a con man.
entries.I underestimated you, “cousin” — it seem: I underestimated you, ‘cousin’ — it seems you’re more than just a good actor and a pretty face. I may be forced to flee the field today, but this isn’t over.
entries.Pigs will fly before the silver city bow: Pigs will fly before the silver city bows to any queen. After the thrashing we gave them, they won’t return any time soon.
Bah, this is starting to get ridiculous. I’m not sticking around for ever, no matter what your queen promises me!
entries.Hahaha, this town is great! Top-quality: Ha ha ha, this town is great! Top-quality slaves, houses made with real shingles, and all the gold and silver in the world!
entries.Hark, Konrad! One of the cityfolk steals: Hark, Konrad! One of the city-folk steals across the river towards our shore!
entries.Look there, Konrad. Dosh is seein’ a sof: Look there, Konrad. Dosh is seein’ a soft-skin sneakin’ across dis river towards us.
entries.Greetings, friend. I am Reglok, guildmas: Greetings, friend. I am Reglok, guild master of the Elensefar thieves. We would like to help you against the orcs.
entries.Is that so? What honor is there among th: Is that so? What honour is there among thieves? We do not trust you and we do not need you.
entries.You shall find that there is honor, even: You shall find that there is honour, even among thieves. We served Maddock well, and if you can liberate Elensefar we shall do the same for you.
entries.There is a hidden ford on the southwest: There is a hidden ford on the south-west side of the city, but coming from the north that shall be of little use. Instead, we shall lay in wait until you give us a signal then ambush the orcs’ rear.
entries.When you raise your blue banner over any: When you raise your blue banner over any village in the city proper, we will see the sign and attack from the city’s centre. Expect $thief_count of us to join the attack.
entries.Information, child. There is a hidden fo: Information, child. There is a hidden ford on the south-west side of the city. Very few people know about it, least of all the orcs. I can show you how to cross.
entries.Very well. When you raise your blue bann: Very well. When you raise your blue banner over any village in the city proper, we will see the sign and attack from the city’s centre.
entries.Magic of this caliber is most rare and h: Magic of this calibre is most rare and hard-to-come-by! I shall wear them myself, and be grateful for the boon. Now, to finish off the remaining orcish leader.
entries.They say the best defense is a good offe: They say the best defence is a good offence, no? I place the thieves of Elensefar in your service, your exaltedness, ready to take the fight to the dark queen.
entries.Our battle has dragged on too long; Elen: Our battle has dragged on too long; Elensefar is all but destroyed. Even if we defeat these orcs, the city will never-again return to its former splendour...
entries.... well aye, o’ course I’m workin’ for: ...well aye, o’ course I’m workin’ for her! Ain’t this the middle o’ Wesnoth? Who else would be in charge, that good-for-nothin’ rebel Konrad? Hey— did I say 70-30? I meant 50-50!
entries.Tha’s a ripe load o’ tripe if ah’ve e’er: Tha’s a ripe load o’ tripe if ah’ve e’er heard one! What kind o’ dwarf-traitor slack-jaw gives up ’is own kind? An’ this IS Prince Konrad, you numbskull! Show some respect!
entries.Work together with me now, an’ once I’ve: Work together with me now, an’ once I’ve cleaned out the nests I’ll let you have your pick of the eggs. Gryphons’re worth a heap in a scrap, ye ken?
entries.Those armored warriors would surely have: Those armoured warriors would surely have been of great help in our fight for the crown. If only we could have protected them...
entries.How odd. In death, this skeleton was a p: How odd. In death, this skeleton was a puppet. But in life, he or she must have been a craftsman of legendary skill. Fortune has smiled upon us today — I will take this artefact for myself.
entries.Lo and behold! We have won a bright vict: Lo and behold! We have won a bright victory against the forces of darkness, good warrior. My brothers and I would be honoured to continue fighting by your side.
entries.... but what calamity is this? Undead! T: ...but what calamity is this? Undead! The sacred seal has broken!
entries.Dark magic streams forth from the underl: Dark magic streams forth from the under-levels, granting terrible un-life to things sprung from the deepest nightmares of humanity. With the spell broken that once sealed them below, the undead emerge to destroy us all!
entries.Without the ruby? No. There are none ali: Without the ruby? No. There are none alive today, save perhaps the great Delfador, with the might to again from-nought weave such a seal.
entries.The seal shattered, my home imperiled, m: The seal shattered, my home imperilled, my friends slain. This is the work of a dozen lifetimes undone.
entries.I am sorry. I cannot battle today. I mus: I am sorry. I cannot fight today. I must meditate, and ponder on my emotions.
entries.For too long have we been trapped by you: For too long have we been trapped by your accursed seal! The under-tunnels shall be thrown open and our followers shall flood across the land! You cannot stop the eternal life that we bring!
entries.As tempting as the thought may be, I’ve: As tempting as the thought may be, I’ve heard more than a few stories of promising young magi tempted by necromancy. It never ends well.
As tempting as the thought may be, I’ve seen more than a few promising young magi tempted by necromancy. It never ends well.
entries.Moremirmu has returned! He has gained +2:
Moremirmu has returned! He has gained +2 damage, +20 hit-points,
and the powerful ‘smite’ ability!

Smite: each time Moremirmu strikes a finishing blow, he will deal
30 arcane damage to all adjacent enemies.
entries.What about the prisoners, m’lady? Shall: What about the prisoners, m’lady? Shall we execute them before the impostor arrives?
entries.C’mere and try it, ye yellow-bellied, co: C’mere and try it, ye yellow-bellied, cow-handed blunderbuss of a princess! Jus’ gimme the chance an’ I’ll rip that head right off yer ninny-hammerin’ neck, ye white-livered gasser!
entries.Oh please, the dwarves were never in any: Oh please, the dwarves were never in any danger. You on the other hand, ‘prince’ — I will not allow you to sow any more discord and chaos among my people. Your rebellion ends here.
entries.For Her Highness! Kill the imposter!: For Her Highness! Kill the impostor!
entries.Caution, Konrad! These hills are full of: Caution, Konrad! These hills are full of old mine-shafts, their entrances overgrown with grass and weeds. Li’sar must be using them to ambush us.
entries.Look out, Your Highness! Your cousin has: Look out, Your Highness! Your cousin has stationed ambushers across the hills, lurking in old mine-shafts.
entries.Where did you come from?! Careful, Konra: Where did you come from?! Careful, Konrad, I think there are ambushers hiding in old mine-shafts all across these hills.
entries.Lo! The forces of evil ambush us at ever: Lo! The forces of evil ambush us at every turn — even the very ground itself succours our foes within its old mines.
entries.Those ambushers burst right out of the g: Those ambushers burst right out of the ground! There must be old mine-shafts everywhere in these hills, overgrown with grass and weeds.
entries.Wait, stop! I’m not an imposter, I’m the: Wait, stop! I’m not an impostor, I’m the real Konrad!
entries.... there’s nothing I can say to save th: ...there’s nothing I can say to save these woodsmen, is there?
entries.Much better, thank ye for freein’ us! Th: Much better, thank ye for freein’ us! Tha’s the last time I dig a mine for yer human queen, lemme tell you. ‘Clean up the old crossroads mines’, she says. ‘The princess needs ’em for somethin’!’
entries.An’ now tha’s my job gone; guess I got n: An’ now tha’s my job gone; s’ppose I got nought left fer me now but revenge. So if yer out to beat the queen, me an’ my boys are with ye!
entries.... hey, what the— that axe! That axe yo: ...hey, what the— that axe! That axe you’re holdin’, that’s my father’s!
entries.Get off me, dwarf! I can’t fall here; th: Get off me, dwarf! I can’t fall here; there’s too much left to do. I may be forced to flee the field today, ‘cousin’, but I will not rest until you face justice for all the chaos you have caused.
entries.So, Delfador “the Great” draws the blood: So, Delfador ‘the Great’ draws the blood of his betters once more. Do not expect me to repeat the mistakes of my brother, old man — I shall flee the field today, but I will not rest until you and your puppet face justice for all the chaos you have caused.
entries.So “cousin”, it seems you’re more than j: So ‘cousin’, it seems you’re more than just a good actor and a pretty face. No matter — I may be forced to flee the field today, but I will not rest until you and your puppet-master face justice for all the chaos you have caused.
entries.Lieutenant, weren’t we expecting a weapo: Lieutenant, weren’t we expecting a weapons convoy some hours ago? I hope they haven’t got into any trouble.
entries.Sorry, I done already told you, softskin: Sorry, I done already told you, soft-skin. You gots to pay if you wants to cross. Stoneskins fight hard to own ford, kill lotsa other trolls ’n orcs. Dosh kill you too, no big whoop.
entries.Fulfill your pledge: end the scenario wi: Fulfil your pledge: end the scenario with at least $bm_s22_gold_cost gold
entries.Dey ain’t so bad. No reason for us to be: Dey ain’t so bad. No reason for us to be fighting. Dosh gonna talk to dem.
entries.A foul odor. A blight upon the wind. Kon: A foul odour. A blight upon the wind. Konrad, this is a gateway created by the lich-lords of ages past, during their genocidal hunt for the Ruby.
entries.Yet the Light has delivered us, for toda: Yet the Light has delivered us, for today we stand whole and strong. This gateway died long ago. May it remain so until the end of days, until the sun itself rains down from the heavens as sulphur and fire and all the darkness is cleansed from this world.
entries.Dis da great orc-gate, Konrad. Once, lon: Dis da great orc-gate, Konrad. Once, long ago, lots o’ dem used it to come here from far away and fight you soft-skins. But dey didn’t build it, and now dey don’t know how to turn it back on again. Maybe nobody ever will.
entries.Urgh... that sound hurts my head somethi: Urgh... that sound hurts my head terribly. I’ve heard a lot o’ orc-horns before, Konrad, an’ this one ain’t normal.
entries.Gah! Now thar’s a sound to split an eard: Gah! Now thar’s a sound to split an eardrum! Ah’ve heard plenty o’ scum-breed half-dog war-horns before, Konrad, but this one ain’t normal.
entries.Ow! Ow, ow, that hurts my ears, and sets: Ow! Ow, ow, that hurts my ears, and sets my bones all a-shaking! That can’t be a mundane, every-day war-horn, can it?
entries.Dat’s a bad sound for us, Konrad. Dosh b: Dat’s a bad sound for us, Konrad. Dosh been hearin’ dis horn before — it’s not no normal war-horn. It’s got some kind of orc-magic.
entries.That’s it! You pinkskins are proving way: That’s it! You pink-skins are proving way too much of a nuisance. I’m finding the high chief and bringing his warriors back from their raid!
entries.Most of the herbs, you see, I’ve had no: Most of the herbs, you see, I’ve had no trouble collecting. Err, but, well, the local fauna — as you may surmise, the fauna has proven somewhat less co-operative than for which I was prepared... Right! But now you’re here to help!
entries.Yes, ingredients, precisely! And if you: Yes, ingredients, precisely! And if you did take the time to help me, I’d be very grateful. And... and! If you help me, I’ll help you in return and come with you on your quest. A great chance to field-test my concoctions against that queen of yours.
entries.I only need three more ingredients to co: I only need three more ingredients to complete my experiments. Icemonax bile. Giant Spider venom — that a tough one. And, err, believe it or not, Yeti tongue. If Yetis exist.
entries.... and if we can collect all three of t: ...and if we can collect all three of these, you’ll come with us to help us fight against Asheviere? I suppose that sounds like a fair trade.
entries.Brrr... this is a far cry from the warm: Brrr... this is a far cry from the warm shores of Alduin. Unless we have very fast warriors, we may have to split up if we want to collect all of Jeniver’s ingredients before we run out of time and the cold drives us away. The north-eastern mountains look especially hard to reach.
entries.We will not be able to fight in this bli: We will not be able to fight in this blizzard for ever, Konrad. Unless we have very fast warriors, we may have to split up if we want to collect all of Jeniver’s ingredients before we run out of time and the cold drives us away. The north-eastern mountains look especially hard to reach.
entries.We won’t be able t’ fight in th’ blizzar: We won’t be able t’ fight in th’ blizzard for ever, Konrad. Unless we have very fast warriors, we might want t’ split up to collect all o’ Jeniver’s ingredients afore we run out o’ time and the cold drives us away. Them north-eastern mountains look ’specially hard t’ reach!
entries.The Light warms us, yet this chill blizz: The Light warms us, yet this chill blizzard takes its toll, Konrad. Unless we have very fast warriors, we may have to split up should we hope to collect all of Jeniver’s ingredients before our time runs short and the cold drives us away. The north-eastern mountains loom especially distant!
entries.We ain’t prepared t’ fight ferever in a: We ain’t prepared t’ fight fer ever in a blizzard like this, Konrad. Lest ye’ve got some very fast warriors, we may be havin’ to split up t’ get all o’ Jeniver’s ingredients afore we run out o’ time and the cold drives us away. Them north-eastern mountains look ’specially hard t’ reach!
entries.Storm too cold, Konrad. Unless you got s: Storm too cold, Konrad. Unless you got some fast fighters, Dosh is thinking we’ve got no time get all da ’gredients unless you splits us up. Otherwise we get too cold and den have to leave. North-east mountains look ’specially hard to be gettin’ to.
entries.We won’t be able to fight in this blizza: We won’t be able to fight in this blizzard for ever. Unless we have very fast warriors, we may have to split up if we want to collect all of your ingredients before we run out of time and the cold drives us away. The north-eastern mountains look especially hard to reach!
...there! Now add essence of wand-weed... bone of the tyrant... a lit torch—stand back!
entries.Smoke! Yes, earth turned to air... most: Smoke! Yes, earth turned to air... most useful for befuddling and bewitching the unprepared, and a validation of my theory of elemental humours!
entries.Jeniver has gained a powerful <i>flashpo: Jeniver has gained a powerful flash-powder attack!
entries.Yes, yes, now one dash of mugwort... ess: Yes, yes, now one dash of mug-wort... essence of sky-worm, heated under a cold flame... and... and— And golden transmutation is achieved!
entries.Err, well, no, not quite. It’s more of a: Err, well, no, not quite. It’s more of a... distillation — yes, a process for refining and extracting more value out of your existing coin. But ‘transmutation’ is a much more exciting word for alchemists. And etymology aside, my discovery will certainly help boost your income!
...Chantal? No, not here... War is no... place for you...
entries.And stay in there. Any pinkskin sticks i: And stay in there. Any pink-skin sticks its head out, it won’t have a head for much longer!
entries.Each surviving slave increases your gold: Each surviving slave increases your gold carry-over by 10.
entries.They tried to knock down the eastern min: They tried to knock down the eastern mine-shaft too, but its since been cleared. Lots o’ orcs and trolls go in, trying to finish off the last dwarves and claim Knalga’s treasure for themselves. That’s the only way underground now.
entries.... Uncle Somf? Is that really you? What: ...Uncle Somf? Is that really you? What’re you doing here!
entries.As we were warned, the central tunnels h: As we were warned, the central tunnels have been collapsed. We shall have to make for the eastern mine-shaft instead.
entries.The central tunnels are collapsed! Maybe: The central tunnels are collapsed! Maybe some of the slaves knew about this, but I freed so few... We shall have to make for the eastern mine-shaft, and hope that entrance is still open.
entries.... not a single slave has escaped along: ...not a single slave has escaped along with us. I had hoped that our good deed here would help us gain new allies, but it seems my hopes were in vain. We must press onwards alone.
entries.That coward, that yaldson, that spawn of: That coward, that yaldson, that spawn of utter darkness is holdin’ my father’s axe! His blood-axe, one o’ the last few in the world!
entries.Aye... like I said ’twere my father’s, b: Aye... like I said ’twere my father’s, but ’tweren’t he who forged it. Been with us dwarves since times o’ legend, have th’ blood-axes. I never thought I’d again see such a sight! Not since th’ dark days began...
entries.Perhaps th’ spirit o’ Knalga ain’t so de: Perhaps th’ spirit o’ Knalga ain’t so dead an’ buried after all. Ah’m a Blood-axe now, like my father an’ his father an’ his father afore him! Ah’m in yer debt once again, Konrad. Ye given me hope.
entries.I know ye’ll be wantin’ all of our warri: I know ye’ll be wantin’ all of our warrior types, but we dinnae have enough o’ everyone to spare. But those we do have are tough, and well-practised in the art of battle.
entries.Whether you get yer throne back or not,: Whether you get yer throne back or not, you’ll always be welcome in Knalga — what remains o’ it, at least. Between the trolls in the west an’ the orcs in the Doors we’re just spread too thinly. Mebbe if those were gone...
entries.The last dwarvish ruin far behind them,: The last dwarvish ruin far behind them, the party descended into the deepest parts of the hewn caverns. Except for disturbances caused by the occasional rodent, the air in the lower passages was still and tomb-like.
We’ve been travelling for days upon days. Surely the Sceptre is getting close!
entries.Growin’ up they used to tell me fairytal: Growin’ up they used to tell me fairy-tales about the Sceptre... Never thought I might actually be seein’ it in person. Which way do we go, Delfador?
entries.Dis cave good place for troll, but no go: Dis cave good place for troll, but no good place for soft-skins. Better find your scep-tar an’ get back to sun-lit places. Which way should we start?
entries.Delfador, you’ve told me the importance: Delfador, you’ve told me the importance of the Sceptre of Fire. And I believe you! A powerful magical artefacts, and the fabled symbol of the kings of Wesnoth. With the Sceptre in my hand even Asheviere would struggle to deny my claim to the throne.
entries.Delfador... other than the prophecy abou: Delfador... other than the prophecy about the Sceptre, you haven’t been keeping any other secrets from me ‘for my own good’, have you?
entries.Aye, tha’s nice... except there’s nothin: Aye, tha’s nice... except there’s nothin’ here, ye cloud-headed flap-dragon! It’s an empty cave!
entries.On the contrary! My research leads me to: On the contrary! My research leads me to believe that we stand in the centre of a dormant volcano, which erupted centuries ago and buried the Sceptre in rock. It is indeed here, under the cave floor.
entries.We’ve burned the trolls out of the easte: We’ve burned the trolls out of the eastern tunnels. Our way forwards is clear.
entries.(gain the Sceptre of Fire, and special a: (gain the Sceptre of Fire, and special armour for Konrad)
entries.You really are just a child. Maybe the A: You really are just a child. Maybe the Aethenwood runs on friendship and flowers, but here in the real world sometimes people get hurt. And yes, sometimes that means unsavoury decisions, like the kind the queen has to make every day.
entries.... not bad, as hero speeches go. We’ll: ...not bad, as hero speeches go. We’ll see how the palace dungeons change your tune.
entries.You done made wrong enemy, softskin!: You done made wrong enemy, soft-skin!
entries.I have found an exit from the cavern! Qu: I have found an exit from the cavern! Quickly, everyone, follow me and we may yet evade Li’sar within the twisting tunnels!
entries.I am not the cause of these tremors — wh: I am not the cause of these tremours — what does that fool mage of yours think she is doing? The volcano is awakening! Is she trying to kill us and you both!?
entries.What have you done, old man? You hold so: What have you done, old man? You hold something that looks exactly like my armour, finely crafted and inscribed with symbols of royalty, yet what I still wear is intact. How is this possible?
entries.I have no love for the villains who trie: I have no love for the villains who tried to take my life, but neither am I willing to doom my comrades just to spite them. That is how Asheviere fights; more invested in the death of enemies than the life of friends — or daughters. Did you yourself not tell me ‘be forgiving, be wise, be kind’?
entries.I have no love for the villain who tried: I have no love for the villain who tried to take my life, but neither am I willing to doom my comrades just to spite her. That is how Asheviere fights; more invested in the death of enemies than the life of friends — or daughters. Did you yourself not tell me ‘be forgiving, be wise, be kind’?
entries.Although she is our enemy, I believe tha: Although she is our enemy, I believe that she is trustworthy enough to honour her word if she agrees not to harm us. I ask you to trust my judgement on this, my mentor.
entries.Li’sar is not Eldred. Although she is ou: Li’sar is not Eldred. Although she is our enemy, I have come to believe Her Highness cares about her people just as we do, and that she is trustworthy enough to honour her word if she agrees not to harm us. I ask you to trust my judgement on this, my mentor.
entries.I am not here to fight you, Li’sar — at: I am not here to fight you, Li’sar — at least not right now. You are vulnerable, but so are we, and if we wage war the only winner will be the undead. I propose a truce.
entries.... not that it matters, because I can s: ...not that it matters, because I can see that my soldiers have barely enough to outfit themselves as it is. It’s unfortunate that the queen’s orders harmed us as much as they did you, if not more.
entries.... not that it matters, because we have: ...not that it matters, because we have barely enough to outfit ourselves as it is. It’s unfortunate that the queen’s orders harmed us as much as they did you, if not more.
entries.It’s not “unfortunate” — your mother was: It’s not ‘unfortunate’ — your mother was more than willing to see you killed.
entries.“<i>The dark queen</i>,” pfft. I’ve hear: ‘The dark queen,’ pfft. I’ve heard enough slander; hold your tongue or I shall have my men make an end to our truce and short work of you.
‘The dark queen,’ pfft. I’ve heard enough slander; hold your tongue or I shall make an end to our truce and short work of you.
entries.You can’t deny, Li’sar, that th’ queen o: You can’t deny, Li’sar, that th’ queen o’ yours was ready to massacre us small-folk in Delwyn an’ Dallben jus’ because we refused to swear fealty. An’ she would’ve succeeded too, if we hadn’t fought back an’ fled an’ hid!
entries.You cannot deny, cousin, that Asheviere: You cannot deny, cousin, that Asheviere was ready to massacre the small-folk in Delwyn and Dallben just because they refused to swear fealty. They told me the story: had they not fought back and fled and hid, they would all be dead now.
entries.The lich is defeated, Li’sar, and our ag: The lich is defeated, Li’sar, and our agreed-upon truce comes to an end. If your soldiers and I are to fight, know that even weakened from the caves they shall still find me a formidable foe.
The lich is defeated, Li’sar, and our agreed-upon truce comes to an end. If we are to fight, know that even weakened from the caves you shall still find me a formidable foe.
entries.Now get out of here. You pinkskins and y: Now get out of here. You pink-skins and your politics have caused me enough trouble already...
entries.Konrad can only recruit or recall during: Konrad can only recruit or recall during this scenario’s first turn. Next turn, Fagh-mok will sneak all your units into the centre of the orcish camp.
entries.Stupid runtling, quit trembling! What’re: Stupid runtling, quit trembling! What’re you so afraid of? Go through and get everything to the stockpiles.
entries.Hurry on past, goblin. I don’t want your: Hurry past, goblin. I don’t want your stench in my nose while I’m trying to eat.
entries.Let us lift the latch on their fence gat: Let us lift the latch on their fence gate, then quietly leave before anyone notices...
entries.Look at all those weapons! This must be: Look at all those weapons! This must be one of their armouries.
entries.Find the survivor near the southeast cor: Find the survivor near the south-east corner of the map.
entries.With more specimens, I’m sure I could le: With more specimens, I’m sure I could learn something practical. If you could kill, say, err, thirty drakes — not including this one, that is — then I’m sure their fire could show me how to improve my flash-powder.
entries.What honor is there in the heart of a ma: What honour is there in the heart of a man who has served Asheviere; who pursued us underground and fought to kill us? Will he follow you, or will he choose to betray us to the dark queen?
entries.Aye, so said the scorpion to the frog! D: Aye, so said the scorpion to the frog! Dinnae forget, that ninny-hammerin’ cad tried to kill Konrad not so long ago, same as all them other chuckle-heads who fought us underground! He’ll betray us to Asheviere quick as a wink.
entries.There is an old book here, labeled <i>“I: There is an old book here, labelled ‘Isaac Mallat — Journal.’ The running water has washed away most of the ink, but one passage is still readable...
entries.I see it — a pouch of powdered sapphire!: I see it — a pouch of powdered sapphire! A valuable component for all kinds of spells. I used the last of my supply in the defence of Elensefar, and have sorely missed it since. Thank you for your gift, Haralamdum.
entries.“These youths”, you dare call us? Don’t: ‘These youths’, you dare call us? Don’t think me so weak that I cannot prove my worth in pitched battle.
entries.How can this be?! You have bested me in: How can this be?! You have bested me in combat! Impossible... but true. I will honour my pledge to join your army.
entries.Bah, a humiliating defeat! But a defeat: Bah, a humiliating defeat! But a defeat nonetheless. Let it not be said that Sir Rugan is without honour — as agreed, I will join your army.
entries.And as a gesture of goodwill, I instead: And as a gesture of goodwill, I instead offer you our war-chest; a vast reserve of supplies and coin to sustain you on your crusade.
entries.Gryphons will appear periodically near t: Gryphons will appear periodically near the north-west corner of the map. They aren’t your allies, but will prefer to attack Isolde’s soldiers when given the choice.
entries.Li’sar, as a general of Wesnoth you were: Li’sar, as a general of Wesnoth you were surely familiar with Dan’Tonk’s defences. Do you have any insight into its weaknesses? Is there anything we can use against the general?
entries.That orc’s keep will make a perfect stag: That orc’s keep will make a perfect staging ground for our attack on the city, Konrad. I’ll move forwards and recruit from there once it’s clear. You’re welcome to share, of course.
entries.This unit will not detonate if overkille: This unit will not detonate if over-killed by 25 hit-points or more, as long as the vanquishing damage type is not fire.
entries.Should’ve taken me up on my offer when y: Should’ve taken me up on my offer when you had the chance, Konrad. If I can’t kill the chief, maybe I can still win his favour by killing you!
entries.Delfador! You utterly disgust me, you sn: Delfador! You utterly disgust me, you snivelling worm. How dare you confront me, your queen?
entries.... Mage Protector of The Kingdom Of The: ... Mage Protector of The Kingdom of The Peoples of The West-North, Chief Adviser to the Crown...
entries.... and personal counselor to my King an: ... and personal counsellor to my King and my friend, Garard the Second, whom you most foully betrayed...
entries.Delfador became Li’sar’s High Counselor,: Delfador became Li’sar’s High Counsellor, advising her in the most important matters of state. He lived until a ripe old age and was granted a royal funeral, after which he was buried in the Royal Crypt in Weldyn.
entries.Moremirmu lived the rest of his days as: Moremirmu lived the rest of his days as a wandering warrior, bringing light and hope wherever he went. When at last he fell, he was buried with honours and laid to rest among the other heroes of his order.
entries.Jeniver swallowed her pride and traveled: Jeniver swallowed her pride and travelled to Alduin. At Delfador’s insistence she was awarded a professorship, and would go on to contribute greatly to the advancement of alchemy and the training of young minds.
entries.Inspired by Konrad’s leadership, Elrian: Inspired by Konrad’s leadership, Elrian forwent his study of magic and instead devoted himself to the study of strategy. In time, he would become one of the Crown’s top generals.
entries.Konrad kept his promise to Merle, channe: Konrad kept his promise to Merle, channelling gold and attention towards the Dulatus hills. That place became known as a home of great craftsmen.
entries.Jotha eventually returned to his home in: Jotha eventually returned to his home in the north, this time alongside many other merfolk. The Bay of Jotha (so it came to be called) would grow into a prosperous settlement; a rare jewel of civilization in the northern wild-lands.
entries.—and the outskirts are barely a day’s ma: —and the outskirts are barely a day’s march away. We should approach from the north-east, using the river to cover our flank. She’ll cut off our supply chain if we give her the chance.
entries.Delfador, I am honored. And Konrad... I’: Delfador, I am honoured. And Konrad... I’m just as surprised by this revelation as are you. In truth, you’d nearly had me convinced we were of one blood. I can’t call you my cousin any more, now.
entries.According to legend, the mystical blooda: According to legend, the mystical blood-axes were forged at the dawn of time in the great stone-fires of Dhur Darihm, when all Irdya was still drowned in flame and soot. It is with them that the first dwarves made war against the troll-mother, laying low her people and for evermore claiming dominion in the under-earth.
entries.While the truth of this legend is a matt: While the truth of this legend is a matter of debate, battlefield reports leave no doubt that such weapons exist, and that they confer great resilience upon their wielder. The dwarves’ few remaining blood-axes are jealously guarded, passed down from father to son and reclaimed from the fallen even at great cost.
entries.This unit ignores most movement costs, b: This unit ignores most movement costs, bypasses Zone of Control, and always has at least 50% defence.
entries.In contrast with more overtly magical fi: In contrast with more overtly magical fields of scholarship, practitioners of alchemy are concerned with the study of physical matter — especially herbs, minerals, and the four humours.
entries.The most talented captains undergo exten: The most talented captains undergo extensive training in various military styles, including those of the elves and orcs. Well seasoned in the art of war, they are unorthodox but brilliant strategists who can direct even the freshest recruits to strike strategically against imposing odds and emerge victorious. Outfitted in finely-made weapons and armour, these leaders are a force to be reckoned with in both warfare and single combat.
entries.Armed with a blessed sword and channelin: Armed with a blessed sword and channelling their light towards the mending of their own wounds, such a warrior proves a potent ally against all things unnatural.
entries.Quintains are used to practice swordplay: Quintains are used to practise swordplay and jousting on.
entries.Juvenile gryphon are covered with white: Juvenile gryphon are covered with white and grey feathers, softer and more luxurious than those of their adult relatives. By the time they learn to fly, most have already grown larger than a wolf, and are more than capable of defending their nests from intruders.
entries.I know something of the history of the e: I know something of the history of the elves. Delfador says that you once lived as if in a dream, untroubled by even the rumour of strife. That sounds an envious life.
entries.I was but a young man when your father f: I was but a young man when your father fell, barely come of age. Garard bestowed much favour upon the Horse Clans, but only so long as we trained ever-greater numbers of young men for his cavalry.
entries.What of justice for Garard? What of our: What of justice for Garard? What of our honour? Once, the Clans stood for those ideals. How far you have fallen.
entries.To be honest, studying magic was more my: To be honest, studying magic was more my family’s dream than mine. My grandparents are ‘new money’; wealthy merchants from the east side of Tath. (As an aside — we should visit them if we’re ever in the area.)
To be honest, studying magic was more my family’s dream than mine. My grandparents are ‘new money’; wealthy merchants from the east side of Tath. You’ve already been there and met them.
entries.That “Provost Seimus” we fought at Aldui: That ‘Provost Seimus’ we fought at Alduin seemed like a powerful mage. It’s a shame he decided to side with Asheviere instead of joining us as you did, Elrian.
entries.Now, I have taken up the sword and ventu: Now, I have taken up the sword and ventured forth in search of evil to smite. And lo! You and I united, and lo! Now we journey together against the evils of Asheviere.
entries.Konrad, how come you never asked me just: Konrad, why have you never asked me just how we all came to live on the Three Sisters? It be a powerful story, an’ one that matters for how you’re fightin’ Asheviere too! I’ve been excited to tell you!
entries.... err, but you can still tell me again: ...err, but you can still tell me again. Your parts especially, Harper! I’d always be happy to listen.
entries.You ne’er seemed one for princes or king: You ne’er seemed one for princes or kings, Harper. We fought pretty hard t’ get away from th’ queen. Why’re you fightin’ for this ‘Konrad’ now, an’ draggin’ me into it too?
entries.I appreciate the enthusiasm, but we’re i: I appreciate the enthusiasm, but we’re in no state to confront Asheviere any time soon! For now we should focus on surviving and building up our strength.
entries.No offense meant, my lady. Perhaps we ca: No offence meant, my lady. Perhaps we can discuss your studies in more depth at another time.
entries.Oh! Is that another giant spider? I coul: Oh! Is that another giant spider? I could use some more spider poison, err, venom — I suppose it’s not really poison — for my blow-darts. Can you kill one for me?
entries.Jeniver’s “<i>blowgun</i>” attack can no: Jeniver’s ‘blowgun’ attack can now be used twice each turn!
entries.Jeniver’s “<i>flashpowder</i>” attack ca: Jeniver’s ‘flash-powder’ attack can now be used twice each turn!
entries.Mix with one vial of frostbone... infusi: Mix with one vial of frost-bone... infusion of boar... heat over an open flame...
entries.Ah can’t believe yer expecting me to fig: Ah can’t believe yer expecting me to fight side-by-side with some half-wit, bog-handed, mumble-crest o’ a troll, Konrad. I kin feel my ancestors laughin’ at me from below!
entries.Masterfully crafted by Weldyn smiths, th: Masterfully crafted by Weldyn smiths, then magically duplicated and enhanced by Delfador, this armour grants Konrad +40% resistance to all damage.
entries.This unit has 40% defense and full movem: This unit has 40% defence and full movement on water, swamp, and snow.
At least I die an honourable death...
I have given all in defence of my home...
